data.name: CompassNorth
data.comment: A compass point: where an objective lies from the player's last position, on the map (map-up is north), beside its distance in the raid card and the quest cards: "294 m · NE · 8 M UP" (shown in capitals). As short as the language writes it (German: N, NO, O, SO, S, SW, W, NW).
